scope: Native UnitStatus attack query, three disable timers and callback-driven cancellation/cleanup subset. Not full Effect admission/application/update, allegiance or damage. Static original DLL/PDB; portable smoke separate.

construction.Unit_constructor: RVA2f0bb0 zeroes native status fields beginning Unit+0x460 at1802f0cd1 onward. Pending/delete/active empty, flagsfalse, timerzero.
construction.Unit_Init: VA1802f12f5 takes status atUnit+0x460,1802f12fc assigns owner,1802f1303 calls UnitStatus::Reset.
construction.Reset: Sets move/rotate/attack timers=-1 then restores ally, clears/cleans all effects, block state and immunities. Does not reset cancelable flags. Portable initializeFreshUnit only covers fresh zeroed unit with no effects; existing-unit Reset requires real effects/allegiance callbacks.

returns_false_if: mDisableAttackTime>0 and allowCancellation=false. With allowCancellation=true timer is ignored regardless timer cancelable flag.

Any pending OR active effect DisableAttack=true, except cancelable effects are ignored when allowCancellation=true; remaining effect blocks iff owner.UnitData.ImmuneToStun=false OR effect.SelfApplied=true.
CanAttack.distinction: WeaponOwnerFrame.canAttack and canAttackAllowCancellation are these two query variants; UnitData.CanAttack and weapon enabled/animation checks remain distinct consumers.

timer_advance.formula: Only when timer>0, timer-=unitElapsed*owner.UnitData.StunBreakModifier(full+0x154). Float32 operations; no clamp, equalityzero stops future decrement.
timer_advance.portable_limit: advanceDisableTimers implements only these lines; it is not full UnitStatus::Update.

pending_commit.behavior: Before iterating active Effect::Update, append all pending refs to active in order then clear pending. Native has duplicate search but append is unconditional in shipped assembly; portable preserves actual repeated refs.
pending_commit.ownership: trackAdmittedEffect only tracks actual already-admitted Effect records and owns shared references. It does not stand in for native AddEffect validation/application.

cancellation.input: Actual firing Weapon instance supplies WeaponData.mEffects names atfull+0x998..0x9a0 and CanCancelOwnDisables atfull+0x8f3. Exact-case name comparison.
cancellation.timers: Reset each corresponding timer to-1 only if its cancelable flag istrue.
cancellation.names: Native global CANCELED_EFFECT_NAMES is cleared at every invocation and returned by reference. Portable stores result per UnitStatus; parent must copy this result to the immediate caller and must not present it as persistent native global storage.
cancellation.pending: Iterate initial pending list count. Every Cancelable effect not matching any weapon effect name is cleared ifnotalreadycleared, queued todelete and name appended. Matching pending effects are preserved even when CanCancelOwnDisables=true.
cancellation.active: Iterate initial active list count after pending phase. Same except matching own name is canceled if CanCancelOwnDisables=true.
cancellation.not_limited_to_disables: No DisableMove/Rotate/Attack test in cancel selection; all eligible cancelable effects are candidates.
cancellation.barrier: Virtual Effect::Clear +0x48 is synchronous. Base Clear RVA5d560 immediately marks mCleared+0x2a=true, resolves actual unit, restores animation/property/time multiplier, restores enabled weapons, handles sounds/graphics/force and ultimately ScriptManager::OnEffectCleared RVA28e9b0. Portable requires parent real callback; does not fabricate those actions.
cancellation.deferred: Cancel does not erase effect vectors. CanAttack still sees cleared effect until CleanupEffects removes it.

cleanup.guard: Does nothing while mUpdatingEffects=true. Parent invokes portable cleanup outside original active update iteration.
cleanup.barrier: For every deletion ref, if !mIsDisposed, sets UnitId=-1 before virtual Dispose(true)+0x38, then marks disposed. Removes every matching ref from active and pending and eventually clears delete queue.
cleanup.portable: cleanupEffects requires actual Dispose(true) executor; synthetic success callback alone does not establish original effect disposal.

portable_api.failure_policy: Finite clocks/modifier required, missing real callbacks fail closed with sticky fault. canAttack false while faulted; partial mutation retained. Reentrant cancel/cleanup unsupported explicitly. These guards are reconstruction policies, not claims of original exception handling.
portable_api.integration: Root owns actor/component and weapon adapter calls. No CMake/runtime spine files changed here.

test.kind: Synthetic observers only; covers timers, immune/self effect gates, pending/active cancellation asymmetry, callback ordering, new pending admissions, deferred disposal and missing executor failure.

remaining_unknowns: Effect subclass constructors/compiled defaults and full native AddEffect admission/filtering.
Full Effect::Update execution, duration/refresh/type effects and callback conditions.
UnitData.CanAttack/CanMove actual consumers beyond this status query.
Complete mBlockEffect/allegiance and status reset on an existing effect-bearing actor.
Reentrant nested cancellation side effects and native global result clobbering.

order: Promote current pending entries in original order
Set updating guard and capture initial active references/count
For each actual active effect query current data.TimeModifierFraction and current owner Thing.TimeMultiplier
If fraction<1: effectElapsed=unitElapsed/(((1-ownerTimeMultiplier)*fraction)+ownerTimeMultiplier), with float32 operation boundaries
Invoke actual virtual Effect.Update using effective effectElapsed
True returns append same effect pointer to deletion queue, including original duplicate behavior
Clear updating guard then real cleanup disposal; ownerID=-1 before actual Dispose(true)
effect_update_phase.callback_visibility: New admissions during effects remain pending. Earlier original Clear callbacks can alter owner time multiplier for later effects. Cleanup calls during updating return without disposal.
effect_update_phase.remaining_scope: Block-effect timer and allegiance timeout in UnitStatus.Update remain separate parent behavior; advanceEffects is the exact effect phase, not entire Update.
effect_update_phase.validation: unit_status_effect_phase_smoke ASan+UBSan passed, old unit_status_smoke and self_effects_smoke recompiled and passed

order: Any name in toDelete masks lookup -> null

CanMove_subset.portable: UnitStatus.canMove() covers only move timer and pending/active effect list gates. Parent retains active AnimationData.DisableOwnerMovement and effective speed checks.
CanMove_subset.timer: False iff disableMoveTime>0; equality zero does not block.
CanMove_subset.effects: Any pending or active EffectData.DisableMove at full+0x1af blocks; cleared/disposed/cancelable/selfApplied/immuneToStun are not consulted.
CanMove_subset.separate: UnitData.CanMove controls entry to movement update and is not this query.
CanMove_subset.validation: unit_status_smoke ASan+UBSan passed with positive/zero timer, pending/active and cleared+disposed disableMove coverage.
